## Service Model

## Budget Philosophy
- Project pricing is scope-specific rather than a universal package price.
- Budget can be discussed before material decisions.
- Suitable for focused room projects through larger turnkey interiors.
- Budget-sensitive briefs can prioritise high-impact spaces and essential scope.
- Do not invent fixed package prices, delivery promises or project counts unless published by the studio.
